title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.07695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most existing equivariant architectures for Hamiltonian prediction propagate features in direct-sum spaces of irreducible spherical tensors, whereas the target Hamiltonian is naturally an operator block in a direct-product representation over local orbital and spin bases. This representation mismatch fragments contiguous Hamiltonian blocks, obscures direct manipulation of orbital couplings, and organizes features into irregular angular-momentum components that require numerous transformations and are poorly aligned with efficient hardware execution and memory management. To address both the representation mismatch and computational bottleneck, we propose DP-Learner, an equivariant learning framework that performs message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space. translated_title: 直积空间中的等变深度学习用于电子结构哈密顿量预测
translated_abstract: 大多数现有的用于哈密顿量预测的等变架构是在不可约球张量的直和空间中传播特征，而目标哈密顿量本质上是局部轨道和自旋基的直积表示中的一个算符块。这种表示不匹配割裂了连续的哈密顿量块，模糊了对轨道耦合的直接操作，并将特征组织成不规则的角动量分量，这些分量需要大量变换，且难以与高效的硬件执行和内存管理相适配。为了同时解决表示不匹配和计算瓶颈问题，我们提出了DP-Learner，一个在直积空间中直接对类哈密顿量算符块进行消息传递的等变学习框架。在理论上，我们提出了基于李生成子的方向嵌入以及不变加权的左右乘积与收缩运算……
tldr: 提出DP-Learner框架，在直积空间中直接对类哈密顿量算符块进行等变消息传递，同时解决了传统直和表示与哈密顿量之间的表示不匹配问题及计算效率瓶颈。
en_tdlr: DP-Learner is an equivariant learning framework that performs message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in direct-product space, addressing both the representation mismatch of conventional direct-sum approaches and the associated computational bottlenecks for electronic-structure Hamiltonian prediction.
